programme.title: XXX: State of the Union

programme.title: Father Stu
programme.desc: Upon suffering in an accident, an aspiring actor receives a vision guiding him to change his lifestyle. However, when he sets off to pursue the priesthood, a rare disease brings him more challenges.

programme.title: The Equalizer
programme.desc: Robert McCall gives up violence and wishes to lead a quiet life. However, brutal events force him to take up the fight for justice once again.

programme.title: Friends With Benefits
programme.desc: A recruiter from New York gets a man recruited at a company and soon, they become friends. However, things get confusing when sex is involved in their relationship.

programme.desc: Smurfette and her friends go to the Forbidden Forest to find a lost village. When the evil wizard Gargamel gets to know of this, he devises a plan to stop the smurfs from discovering the town.

programme.title: You Don't Mess With the Zohan
programme.desc: Zohan, an Israeli anti-terrorist commando, stages his own death when he gets tired of his job and goes to New York City to follow his dream of being a hairstylist.

programme.title: Harold and the Purple Crayon
programme.desc: Harold's drawings spring to life when he ventures into the real world. His purple crayon accidentally creates challenges and he and his friends must safeguard both worlds.

programme.title: Brightburn

programme.title: Men in Black 3

programme.title: Uncharted

programme.title: Hellboy

programme.title: Jumanji: The Next Level

programme.title: Charlie's Angels
programme.desc: Charlie, a wealthy mystery figure, tasks three capable and captivating women with the job of finding Eric Knox, a genius in software development and the leader of Knox Enterprises.

programme.title: The Unholy

programme.title: 28 Days Later
